subject: Sept exec workshop: Aurum CPO travel & EA logistics

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Aurum CPO visit — travel & EA coordination (Sept 20-21)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for helping set this up. Our CPO (Alex Durand) is planning to be in SF on Sept 20-21 for the workshop. Can you confirm who on your side will be the EA/ground contact and whether Redwood will manage arrival/departure logistics or if we should book travel on our end? A few quick items from our side: 

- EA contact for day-of coordination and any dietary/parking notes
- Preferred hotel(s) and rooming block (if you reserve)
- AV/room setup and capacity for 12 (breakouts + main session)
- Any pre-visit security or visitor badge info we should pass to our team

I attached our draft agenda to start (Exec_visit_agenda_v1.xlsx). Monique Harris (my EA) will be handling calendar coordination — I'll loop her once we have the details. 

Thanks,
Sabrina
Sabrina Cole
CPO, Aurum Capital

+1 415-555-0189

Subject: Re: Aurum CPO visit — travel & EA coordination (Sept 20-21)

Hi Sabrina — great to hear. Happy to own on-site coordination from Redwood. Quick answers up front:

- EA / ground lead: Laura Bennett (EA, Programs) will be your day-of contact and advance lead. She'll handle badges, meet-and-greet, and catering confirmations.
- Travel: We prefer customers book travel and we handle ground ops, but we can provide recommended itineraries and a hotel rooming block at Hotel Meridian.
- AV: we'll bring a technician and standard AV (projector, mic, room mics). Breakout rooms confirmed for up to 12 people.

Next steps from our side:
1) I will send a concise itinerary and a Concur expense link for any Redwood-covered items.
2) Vivek will coordinate flights for our exec (if Redwood is booking).
3) Laura will reach out to Monique to sync EAs and exchange cell numbers.

Attaching the v1 agenda you shared — I'll make a couple edits and send v2 once we lock times.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

415-555-1102

Marissa — quick note on travel options in case Redwood ends up booking Alex's flights:

- Preferred arrival: Sept 19 evening (gives buffer for prep) or morning of Sept 20 if preferred.
- Depart: late evening Sept 21 or morning Sept 22 (flexible).
- Preferred airline: non-stop SFO <-> BOS (Alex prefers nonstop where possible).

I'll draft two itineraries and share as a redlined table (will put into EA_contact_sheet.csv). If we are not booking, I'll still propose hotel and car service options for Monique to review.

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — looping in Monique (my EA). Monique: we typically handle airfare and submit receipts via Concur; we can share itinerary details with your team. A few housekeeping items from Aurum: 

- Our security team requires full names + IDs 48 hours before arrival for badges.
- Dietary restrictions for Alex: pescatarian, gluten-free.
- Parking: we'll need one VIP parking spot near the loading dock for a 4x4 sedan.

I've attached our travel policy for reference. Monique will coordinate flights and calendar invites.

Best,
Sabrina

- Meet-and-greet at SFO arrivals (approx 4:00pm PT on 9/19)
